executive.title: Executive Summary
executive.summaryPositive: The business recorded total revenue of {{revenue}} across {{transactions}} transactions, achieving a {{trendWord}} {{trend}} growth trend. Monthly average stands at {{monthly}}, with peak performance in {{bestMonth}}. The top {{topLabel}} "{{topCat}}" contributes {{topCatShare}}% of total revenue.
executive.summaryNegative: The business recorded total revenue of {{revenue}} across {{transactions}} transactions, reflecting a {{trendWord}} {{trend}} decline in the trend period. Monthly average stands at {{monthly}}. Immediate attention is recommended to identify root causes and implement corrective strategies. The top {{topLabel}} "{{topCat}}" contributes {{topCatShare}}% of total revenue.
executive.alertConsecutiveHigh: Revenue has declined for {{count}} consecutive periods — investigate demand drivers immediately.
executive.alertConsecutiveMid: Two consecutive periods of revenue decline detected — monitor closely.
executive.alertRevenueTrend: Overall revenue trend is down {{pct}}% — significant underperformance vs prior period.
executive.alertConcentration: High revenue concentration: top item accounts for {{pct}}% of sales — consider diversifying.
executive.alertMomSharp: Last period MoM growth is {{pct}}% — sharp decline requires urgent review.
executive.highlightStrongTrend: Strong upward trajectory: {{pct}} overall growth — business momentum is excellent.
executive.highlightPositiveTrend: Positive revenue trend of {{pct}} — stable growth maintained over the period.
executive.highlightBestMonth: Peak performance in {{month}} at {{revenue}} — study this period's drivers.
executive.highlightMomGrowth: Most recent period shows {{pct}} MoM growth — positive momentum building.
executive.highlightVolume: High transaction volume of {{count}} records indicates healthy market engagement.

insights.title: AI Insights & Recommendations
insights.noData: Upload more data for advanced insights.
insights.recDiversify: Diversify your revenue streams — your top {{label}} drives {{pct}}% of sales, creating concentration risk. Target at least 3 balanced revenue contributors.
insights.recRecovery: Implement a revenue recovery plan: review pricing strategy, increase marketing spend in low-performing periods, and analyse customer churn patterns.
insights.recUpsell: Accelerate growth by upselling to existing customers — your average transaction value of {{value}} has room to increase through bundling or premium offerings.
insights.recDeclineAnalysis: Conduct a root-cause analysis on the {{count}}-period revenue decline. Consider launching a promotional campaign, re-engaging dormant customers, or entering adjacent markets.
insights.recScaleUp: Capitalize on strong growth momentum by increasing inventory/capacity ahead of demand, scaling marketing efforts, and locking in supplier agreements to protect margins.
insights.recBenchmark: Establish monthly KPI review cycles with clear performance targets. Benchmark your monthly average of {{value}} against industry standards to identify improvement opportunities.
insights.riskStructural: Prolonged revenue decline ({{count}} consecutive periods) suggests structural issues beyond seasonal variation.
insights.riskConcentration: Extreme revenue concentration — {{pct}}% from single source. Any disruption could be severe.
insights.riskSharpDecline: Sharp overall decline of {{pct}} indicates the business may be losing market position.
insights.riskMomContraction: Last-period MoM contraction of {{pct}} is a leading indicator of continued pressure.
insights.oppScale: Positive trend of {{pct}} — now is the right time to invest in scaling operations and customer acquisition.
insights.oppReplicate: Replicate the conditions of your best period ({{month}}, {{revenue}}) — analyse what drove performance and systematise it.
insights.oppDemand: Recent MoM acceleration of {{pct}} signals growing demand — explore whether this trend can be sustained.
insights.oppTopPerformers: Your top performers show clear product-market fit. Consider deepening investment in these lines through new variants, geographic expansion, or B2B channels.
